data.heading: Outcome
data.description: Documentation moved from a largely manual process to a standardized, AI-assisted, governed workflow, with faster authoring and reviews, consistent quality, and approval gates before anything reaches production.

blocks.title: Client & industry
blocks.body: Global technology leader, documenting fast-moving developer products and APIs

blocks.title: Engagement
blocks.body: Technical documentation services, run through an AI-driven authoring, review, and publishing workflow

blocks.title: Scope
blocks.body: API documentation, feature documentation, and greenfield projects, with the workflow adapting to the engineering inputs available

data.heading: Where it started
data.description: Documentation trying to keep pace with fast-moving products through manual handoffs and repeated review cycles.

blocks.title: Business problem
blocks.body: Writers depended on manual collaboration with developers and several rounds of review to keep content aligned with the product. Content fell out of sync as the product changed, and standards varied from one writer to the next.

blocks.title: No decision framework
blocks.body: Version conflicts surfaced late, once content was already in engineering review, and reviewer feedback was worked through by hand. Nothing checked repository status before submission, which stretched each review cycle.

blocks.title: Agivant's role
blocks.body: Technical writing, AI-assisted workflow design, and publication automation across API, feature, and greenfield documentation

data.heading: What Agivant built
data.description: Agivant's technical writers built an AI-driven documentation workflow that keeps final judgment with the human author. An AI assistant validates content as it is written, automation checks repository status before review, AI helps resolve reviewer feedback, and approved content publishes itself. Value in days and weeks.

blocks.title: AI-powered authoring
blocks.body: An integrated assistant enforces client and industry style guides and flags grammar, terminology, and formatting issues as writers work.

blocks.title: Automated quality and version control
blocks.body: Checks repository status and detects conflicting changes before content enters engineering review.

blocks.title: Intelligent review and resolution
blocks.body: AI interprets reviewer feedback and suggests context-aware fixes, while automated notifications keep reviewers aligned through each iteration.

blocks.title: Automated publication
blocks.body: Once every required approval lands, the workflow compiles and publishes the documentation to production.

rows.label: Workflow stages
rows.value: AI-assisted authoring, automated validation, AI-assisted review, automated publication

rows.label: Controls
rows.value: Writer owns every final decision, required approvals before production

rows.label: Next stage (planned)
rows.value: Source-code repository integration for automatic change detection

blocks.title: Before
blocks.body: Manual handoffs, inconsistent standards, late version conflicts, lengthy review cycles, and documentation lagging the product.

blocks.title: After
blocks.body: An AI-assisted workflow with real-time validation, automated conflict checks, assisted review resolution, and approval-gated publishing.

data.heading: Proof in production
data.description: A writer drafts a page while the AI assistant checks it against style, terminology, and formatting rules. Before review, automation confirms the repository is in sync and flags conflicts for the writer to resolve. Reviewer comments come back with suggested fixes the writer accepts or rewrites, and once every approval is in, the page compiles and publishes on its own.

blocks.heading: Measured results
blocks.description: The solution transforms documentation from a largely manual process into a standardized, AI-assisted, and governed workflow.

blocks.label: Authoring, with repetitive editing reduced through AI assistance
Quality, with documentation standards enforced automatically
Risk, through automated version and conflict validation
Workflow, across products and engineering teams

blocks.title: Reusable asset
blocks.body: The workflow repeats across products and engineering teams. Its planned next stage connects to source-code repositories, so documentation-impacting code changes route to the right writer automatically and documentation stays in step with the product. Every build amplifies the next.

blocks.title: Challenges overcome
blocks.body: Supporting API, feature, and greenfield documentation in one workflow when each starts from different engineering inputs, and bringing AI into authoring and review while keeping every final call with the human writer.
